players.product: semiconductor specialty gases: C4F6 etching gas and WF6 tungsten-deposition gas

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report, consolidated, reviewed by Seohyun Accounting): revenue KRW 329,668M, up 42.51% year on year, which the company attributes to broadly higher sales of secondary-battery materials and semiconductor specialty gases plus a larger contribution from subsidiary Hantec. Operating profit KRW 32,661,319,931 against KRW 14,663,236,184 in H1 2025, already above FY2025's full-year KRW 25,349,847,519; Q2 alone revenue KRW 188,221,516,553 (Q2 2025: KRW 124,206,380,449) with operating profit KRW 23,399,254,123 (KRW 14,768,093,614). Mix: fluorine-compound products (semiconductor specialty gases, battery materials, refrigerants, inorganic fluorides) KRW 236,303M or 71.7% of revenue and chemical process equipment (Hantec heat exchangers, reactors, storage tanks) KRW 93,365M or 28.3%; the fluorine-compound segment swung to an operating profit of KRW 14,478M from a FY2025 loss of KRW 12,725M, and its average selling price rose to KRW 28,736/kg from KRW 17,324/kg in FY2025 while its raw-material cost rose to KRW 4,435/kg from KRW 2,663/kg. Parent-only H1 revenue KRW 199,128,117,426 with operating profit KRW 24,114,133,531 (H1 2025: KRW 132,891,633,242 and KRW 8,694,500,302).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 rev KRW 329,668M (+42.51% YoY); H1 OP KRW 32,661,319,931 (vs KRW 14,663,236,184); Q2 rev KRW 188,221,516,553 (vs KRW 124,206,380,449), Q2 OP KRW 23,399,254,123; fluorine compounds 71.7% / chemical equipment 28.3%; fluorine-compound OP KRW 14,478M (FY2025 loss KRW 12,725M); ASP KRW 28,736/kg vs KRW 17,324/kg

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and utilisation (DART half-year report): semiconductor specialty-gas capacity is C4F6 180MT/YR and WF6 400MT/YR at the Ulsan plant plus WF6 500MT/YR at Foosung Advanced Materials (Nantong) in China; battery electrolyte LiPF6 capacity is 2000MT/YR at Ulsan plus a second 2000MT/YR Ulsan line whose trial run is complete and 3400MT/YR at Foosung Technologies (Nantong); a PF3 plant (50MT/YR) was completed in August 2025 and an F2N2 plant (10,000BT/YR) in December 2025. The whole fluorine-compound business ran at 35% utilisation in H1 2026 (production 4,186 tons against half-year capacity of 12,065 tons), and cost of sales carried KRW 9,244M of fixed manufacturing cost from plant production stoppages (H1 2025: KRW 4,006M). The company describes C4F6 as a high-value etching gas whose world market is an oligopoly of 3~4 suppliers and says one additional memory-fab line creates 150~300 ton of extra WF6 demand, with C4F6 and WF6 use rising as 3D NAND and finer processes advance; its semiconductor-gas plan is to raise output through process improvement and win early qualification at domestic customers. Investment: H1 purchases of property, plant and equipment KRW 15,866,238,492, construction in progress KRW 77,703,046 thousand at period end, and a capital-expenditure commitment of KRW 12,464,000 thousand; it also holds a 5 thousand ton fluorspar stockpiling contract with the Public Procurement Service.
quarterly_data.figure: C4F6 180MT/YR; WF6 400MT/YR (Ulsan) + 500MT/YR (Nantong); LiPF6 2000 + 2000 (trial run done) + 3400MT/YR; fluorine-compound utilisation 35% (4,186 of 12,065 tons); KRW 9,244M idle-plant fixed cost; H1 capex KRW 15,866,238,492; capex commitment KRW 12,464,000 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Customers (DART half-year report): Foosung supplies its C4F6 etching gas to semiconductor makers including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, and its refrigerants to Samsung Electronics, LG Electronics, Carrier, Hyundai Motor and Kia; LiPF6 goes to domestic secondary-battery material makers and export. It does not disclose order volumes or backlog for gases or battery materials because supply under its customer contracts moves with demand. One external customer (unnamed) exceeded 10% of consolidated revenue, taking KRW 48,981,049 thousand in H1 2026 (Q2 KRW 28,159,482 thousand) against KRW 39,960,219 thousand in H1 2025; on a parent-only basis a second unnamed customer also passed 10% with KRW 21,480,674 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 8,108,851 thousand). Subsidiary Hantec's chemical-equipment contract backlog stood at KRW 165,803,732 thousand at period end (start of year KRW 155,117,590 thousand).

quarterly_data.counterparty: Samsung, SK Hynix (C4F6 etching gas); LG Electronics, Carrier, Hyundai Motor, Kia (refrigerants)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and new materials (DART half-year report): Foosung opened the Yongin Advanced Materials Research Center in June 2026, moved researchers from the Ulsan plant there and is using etcher equipment from Ulsan to develop new semiconductor materials, in continuing discussions with front-end customers and expecting more customer and government development projects; it says the move needs no additional investment and it will consider more equipment and staff as customer needs grow. Products already commercialised include ultra-high-purity hydrogen fluoride etching gas for semiconductors (a Japanese export-controlled item it localised, now in mass production), and it holds patents on silicon-nitride etching compositions and fluorinated cyclopropane etching gas. H1 R&D spend KRW 4,341M (2.18% of parent revenue).
